item.text: {"source_id":"train-4704-2","response_sha256":"8600b7f85337ae484023cef55cb4292243ee671c78d378f5978e6945a98d048f","status":"supported_error","reference_review_needed":false,"explanation":"The earliest mistake is in Step 2, where the model doubles the second country's four-week stay to obtain eight weeks in the third country. “Twice as long in each of the other two countries” compares both stays with the first country's two weeks, so the third stay is also four weeks."}
